description: (Na)₂LiTlCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiTlCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiTlCl₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TlCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Cl bond lengths are 2.49 Å. Tl is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form TlCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Tl-Cl bond lengths are 2.57 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Tl atom.
